title: AI-Powered Troubleshooting Expansion
summary: Enhance the AI assistant with specialized knowledge modules for VPN connectivity issues, Docker networking problems, Arr service configuration, and Plex/Jellyfin media scanning. Include diagnostic command execution, log analysis, and configuration fix suggestions.

phases.name: Knowledge Modules & Error Pattern Database
phases.description: Create specialized troubleshooting knowledge bases that the AI can reference for common issues

subtasks.title: Create VPN troubleshooting knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for VPN-related issues including 'VPN shows healthy but services can't connect', Gluetun configuration, kill switch problems, and provider-specific issues
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports VPN_TROUBLESHOOTING_KB with issue patterns, diagnostics, and solutions
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive VPN troubleshooting knowledge module with 7 major issue patterns (vpn-healthy-but-no-connection, kill-switch-blocking, auth-failed, dns-leak, port-forwarding-failed, connection-timeout, local-network-unreachable). Includes diagnostic steps, solutions with config examples, search functions, and log pattern matching. Covers Gluetun and major VPN providers (NordVPN, Mullvad, ProtonVPN, Surfshark, PIA).

subtasks.title: Create Docker networking knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for Docker networking issues: container isolation, DNS resolution, port conflicts, network modes, and inter-container communication
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports DOCKER_NETWORKING_KB with common error patterns and solutions
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive Docker networking troubleshooting knowledge module with 11 major issue patterns (container-no-internet, inter-container-dns-failed, port-conflict, network-mode-misconfigured, localhost-not-working, dns-resolution-failed, port-mapping-not-working, bridge-network-mtu-issue, ipv6-connectivity-issue, container-network-isolation). Includes diagnostic steps, solutions with config examples, search functions, and log pattern matching. Covers all common Docker networking scenarios including network modes, DNS, port mapping, inter-container communication, and VPN integration.

subtasks.title: Create Arr service interconnection knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for Sonarr/Radarr/Prowlarr/qBittorrent interconnection issues: API key problems, URL configuration, category mapping, and import failures
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports ARR_INTERCONNECTION_KB covering all common *arr service integration issues

subtasks.title: Create media scanning knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for Plex/Jellyfin media scanning issues: library not updating, file naming conventions, permissions, transcoding problems, and metadata issues
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports MEDIA_SCANNING_KB with patterns for Plex and Jellyfin issues

subtasks.title: Create common error patterns database
subtasks.description: Build a comprehensive error pattern database that maps log messages to known issues and solutions across all services
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports ERROR_PATTERNS with regex patterns, severity levels, and suggested fixes

subtasks.title: Create knowledge base index and search
subtasks.description: Create an index that aggregates all knowledge modules and provides semantic search across troubleshooting content
subtasks.acceptance: Exports searchKnowledge() function that returns relevant troubleshooting entries

phases.name: Enhanced Diagnostic Tools
phases.description: Extend agent tools with specialized diagnostic capabilities for common troubleshooting scenarios

subtasks.title: Create VPN connectivity diagnostic tool
subtasks.description: Build tool to diagnose 'VPN healthy but services can't connect' - checks routing, DNS through VPN, port forwarding, and service network attachment
subtasks.acceptance: diagnose_vpn_connectivity() tool returns detailed analysis with specific recommendations

subtasks.title: Create Arr interconnection diagnostic tool
subtasks.description: Build tool to check Arr service connections: validates API keys, tests endpoints, verifies download client settings, and checks import paths
subtasks.acceptance: diagnose_arr_connections() tool identifies broken connections between services

subtasks.title: Create media scanner diagnostic tool
subtasks.description: Build tool to diagnose Plex/Jellyfin scanning issues: checks library paths, file permissions, naming conventions, and triggers test scans
subtasks.acceptance: diagnose_media_scanner() tool identifies why media isn't being detected

subtasks.title: Enhance log analysis with error pattern matching
subtasks.description: Extend analyzeLogs() to match against ERROR_PATTERNS database and return known issues with solutions
subtasks.acceptance: analyze_logs() returns knownIssues array with matched patterns and solutions

subtasks.title: Create diagnostic command runner with user consent
subtasks.description: Build safe command execution tool for ping, traceroute, DNS tests, curl checks with explicit user consent flow
subtasks.acceptance: run_diagnostic_command() with allowlist of safe commands and consent tracking

phases.name: Troubleshooting History & Context
phases.description: Implement persistent troubleshooting context that carries across conversation turns

subtasks.title: Create troubleshooting session store
subtasks.description: Build service to store troubleshooting sessions with diagnostic results, attempted fixes, and resolution status
subtasks.acceptance: Store saves/retrieves sessions with full diagnostic history

subtasks.title: Integrate troubleshooting context with AI chat
subtasks.description: Modify chat endpoint to inject relevant troubleshooting history into AI context for follow-up questions
subtasks.acceptance: Follow-up questions receive previous diagnostic context automatically

subtasks.title: Add troubleshooting session API endpoints
subtasks.description: Create REST endpoints for managing troubleshooting sessions: list, get, create, update status
subtasks.acceptance: GET/POST /api/ai/troubleshooting/sessions endpoints working

phases.name: Configuration Fix Suggestions & Application
phases.description: Enable AI to suggest and optionally apply configuration fixes

subtasks.title: Create configuration fix generator
subtasks.description: Build service that analyzes detected issues and generates specific configuration fixes (env vars, compose changes, service settings)
subtasks.acceptance: Generator produces actionable fix objects with before/after and apply instructions

subtasks.title: Create safe configuration applier
subtasks.description: Build service to safely apply configuration fixes with backup, validation, and rollback support
subtasks.acceptance: Applier can modify .env files and restart services with rollback on failure

subtasks.title: Add fix suggestion tool for AI
subtasks.description: Create tool that AI can call to generate and present fix suggestions to users
subtasks.acceptance: suggest_config_fix() tool returns user-presentable fix with apply option

subtasks.title: Add fix application endpoint with consent
subtasks.description: Create endpoint that applies a suggested fix after user confirms consent
subtasks.acceptance: POST /api/ai/troubleshooting/apply-fix applies fix with user token validation

phases.name: Enhanced Troubleshoot Agent
phases.description: Update the troubleshoot agent with new capabilities and improved prompts

subtasks.title: Update troubleshoot agent system prompt
subtasks.description: Enhance Dr. Debug agent prompt with knowledge of new diagnostic tools, fix suggestions, and step-by-step troubleshooting methodology
subtasks.acceptance: Troubleshoot agent uses new tools effectively in conversations

subtasks.title: Add new diagnostic tools to AI tool definitions
subtasks.description: Register new diagnostic tools with OpenAI function calling schema in the chat endpoint
subtasks.acceptance: AI can invoke all new diagnostic tools via function calling

subtasks.title: Create troubleshooting workflow orchestrator
subtasks.description: Build logic to orchestrate multi-step troubleshooting workflows (diagnose → analyze → suggest → fix)
subtasks.acceptance: Orchestrator guides user through complete troubleshooting flow

phases.name: Frontend Integration
phases.description: Update the AIAssistant component to support new troubleshooting features

subtasks.title: Add troubleshooting mode UI indicators
subtasks.description: Show when AI is in troubleshooting mode with diagnostic progress, fix suggestions display
subtasks.acceptance: UI shows troubleshooting status, diagnostic results, and fix options

subtasks.title: Add consent flow for diagnostic commands
subtasks.description: Implement UI flow for user to approve diagnostic commands before execution
subtasks.acceptance: User can approve/deny diagnostic commands with clear explanation

subtasks.title: Add fix application UI with confirmation
subtasks.description: Implement UI to preview and confirm configuration fixes before applying
subtasks.acceptance: User can see fix diff and confirm/cancel application

phases.name: Testing & Documentation
phases.description: Comprehensive testing and documentation for the troubleshooting features

subtasks.title: Write unit tests for knowledge modules
subtasks.description: Test knowledge base search and pattern matching functions
subtasks.acceptance: Tests cover search accuracy and pattern matching edge cases

subtasks.title: Write integration tests for diagnostic tools
subtasks.description: Test diagnostic tools with mocked Docker outputs
subtasks.acceptance: Tests verify correct diagnosis from sample log/status data

subtasks.title: Write E2E tests for troubleshooting flow
subtasks.description: Playwright tests for complete troubleshooting conversation flow
subtasks.acceptance: E2E tests verify user can complete troubleshooting workflow

risk_factors: Docker socket access required for diagnostics may have security implications
Configuration changes could break user setups if not properly validated
Knowledge base needs to cover wide variety of edge cases
success_metrics: AI correctly diagnoses 'VPN healthy but services can't connect' in test scenarios
Log analysis identifies at least 80% of common error patterns
Arr interconnection troubleshooting guides user to resolution
Fix suggestions are safe and validated before application
